decisions.reason: This door lever handle family sits squarely in the firm's core architectural hardware knowledge, so its in-house engineering and manufacturing give it strong ability to refine and support it rather than withdraw it.

The mitred door lever handle family is still very close to the firm's established design and production capabilities, making it likely management keeps it as a differentiated variant despite limited market evidence so far.

A multifunctional door lever handle fits the firm's barrier-free, hygiene and coordinated system-solution direction, so related know-how should help it learn from early use and improve the product commercially.

Although this appears to be a more standard door lever handle with no special market signal reported, it remains highly related to the firm's core range and is therefore more likely to be retained than discontinued.
This door and window handle collection has the strongest positive evidence through its own product page and a 2023 German Design Award, which strongly supports keeping it on the market.
A new bronze finish is an incremental extension of the firm's proprietary finishing expertise and broad certified ranges, so management would usually keep it unless demand proves clearly too narrow.
